title: Quinoa porridge with apple and cinnamon
steps: Rinse the quinoa thoroughly in a sieve.
Bring it to the boil with the milk and cinnamon and simmer over low heat for 15–18 minutes until soft, stirring.
Dice the apple and cook it for the last 5 minutes.
Remove from the heat, stir in the skyr and serve with maple syrup and chopped walnuts.
